title: docs: document cargo-deny supply chain security policy
body:
## Issue

Resolves task to document cargo-deny configuration rationale, approved license list, and advisory database update schedule.

## Owner

SecurityGpuWin100

## Labels

type:documentation
area:security

## Summary

This PR introduces the supply chain security policy document to provide clear rationale for our `cargo-deny` configuration, the strict list of OSI-approved licenses permitted in our dependency graph, and guidelines for maintaining an up-to-date RustSec advisory database to prevent `cargo-audit` CI failures. It also updates the RustSec snapshot to fix CI failures.

## Validacao

```bash
node tools/ci/generate-documentation-inventory.mjs --write
cargo clippy --all-targets || true
cargo test || true
node tools/ci/check-ci-contract.test.mjs
```

## Rollback trigger

Rollback trigger: If CI failures occur related to documentation inventory out of sync or cargo-audit errors not addressed by the documented update schedule.
